items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: They have performed and recorded with a lengthy list of artists including ... Gil Evans.

ctx.x: Keyboardist Dan Wall and drummer Adam Nussbaum are two of the busiest jazz artists on the current scene. They have performed and recorded with a lengthy list of artists including James Moody, Joe Lovano, Henry Mancini and Gil Evans. They have been members of the John Abercrombie Trio since 1991.
Dan and Adam were interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 19, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
